title: Dog Night, 2013 · before
logline: The night before fourteen years: the vet's lot, the Datsun's replacement, and the dog carried out to the Legacy in Wood's arms. Nobody says what the vet said. The strip draws the carrying, which it will draw again next year.

panels.composition: The vet's lot at dusk, the Legacy, WOOD carrying BARNABY out to it.

image.prompt: a man carrying an old dog in his arms across a small parking lot toward a faded green station wagon at dusk, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: The dog's face over Wood's shoulder, looking back at the clinic door.

image.prompt: an old dog's face over a man's shoulder looking back at a clinic door, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: WOOD setting him on the passenger seat, the blanket already there.

image.prompt: a man setting an old dog gently onto a car's passenger seat where a folded blanket waits, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: WOOD's hand on the dog before he shuts the door.

image.prompt: a man's hand resting on an old dog on a car seat before the door is closed, black ink with one spot tone

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: What the vet said: not said. The carrying, first.
